nom: Peter Thomas Roth Instant FIRMx Temporary Face Tightener

avis.titre: Read the directions and do just that
avis.texte: This really works. You just need to realize that you don't need a lot and learn how to apply it correctly. Understand what TEMPORARY means and you will give this product 5 stars. This product works just like the one for the eyes.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I am getting older, and do not like how the skin around my eyes and neck are revealing my age more than I care to admit. This product tightens up the skin to reduce the aging appearance which helps reduce how tired I am and makes my eyes look better and reduce the wrinkled chicken neck.

avis.titre: I love this enough to marry it!
